purpose: Create a durable ownership and provenance intake rule for software intended to be held by SauceApproved enterprise LLC without overstating chain of title or third-party rights.

ownershipModel.defaultBusinessIntent: Software created, commissioned, acquired, or maintained specifically for the enterprise is intended to become an enterprise portfolio asset.

currentCanonicalAssets.name: Hercules
currentCanonicalAssets.scope: canonical Hercules platform source, configuration, schemas, workflows, documentation, and original project materials in Sauceapproved7/expert-doodle

currentCanonicalAssets.name: Hercules Browser
currentCanonicalAssets.scope: owned Hercules Browser implementation and repository-defined control, routing, recovery, and operator surfaces

currentCanonicalAssets.name: Hercules Ad Studio
currentCanonicalAssets.scope: hercules-forge/ad-studio and its repository tests and documentation

required: canonical asset name and source location
chain-of-title evidence to SauceApproved enterprise LLC
futureSoftwareIntake.rule: Do not mark an asset enterprise-owned until chain-of-title evidence is recorded.

postAssignmentRepositoryActions: update IP_PROVENANCE.md declared project rights holder
update ownership constants and tests that intentionally bind to the prior rights-holder string
update copyright and licensing notices where legally appropriate without revoking prior valid grants
record the executed assignment reference without publishing private signatures or sensitive personal data

legalEffect.note: This governance record states enterprise intent and workflow. It does not substitute for an executed assignment or other legally sufficient chain-of-title instrument.

ownerOnlyBoundary: Execution of a legally binding IP assignment by the current rights holder.
